name: Frames CLI
role: CLI for framing device screenshots and recordings with bezels
summary: Python CLI that frames screenshots and recordings with device-specific bezels. It supports batch processing, merges, JSON inspection and video exports, including transparent formats on supported macOS and FFmpeg setups. It adds device-aware masks and sizing after capture; it does not capture or animate the app itself.
use_when: Apply device-specific frames to simulator screenshots or recordings
Use the same bezel treatment on stills and video
Batch and merge app-preview captures through a CLI
avoid_when: Need to control or capture a simulator: use a simulator tool
A generic image composite is enough: use ImageMagick
Need general video assembly or encoding: use FFmpeg
license: MIT for CLI code. The separate Apple bezel pack includes Apple's Design Resources License; review its terms for the intended use and redistribution.

install.macos: git clone https://github.com/viticci/frames-cli.git && cd frames-cli && python3 -m pip install Pillow
